subject: Vendr portal: evidence reconciliation & retention sync
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@vendr.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr portal kickoff — inventory snapshot + next steps

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the time today. Per our call, I've attached an initial export from Vendr showing the profile IDs and submission timestamps for TrueNorth Health. I noticed a handful of items that didn't map cleanly to our CAIQ/SIG buckets and wanted to flag them before we push the bulk import into your Whistic/Vendr staging area.

Quick asks from our side:
- Can your team confirm which evidence items require retention metadata (policy, retention period, owner)?
- Any backfilled evidences that need to be marked as historical (do not rotate) vs. active?
- Preferred S3 path for batch ingest (we can also accept a secure transfer link).

I put a short checklist in the attached CSV (vendr_evidence_manifest_v1.csv) — contains the delta rows. If you prefer, we can open a temporary write-only bucket for ingestion.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 20 min sync if it helps.

Regards,
Liam O'Connor
Onboarding Lead, Vendr
liam@vendr.com

Attachment: vendr_evidence_manifest_v1.csv (CSV, 28 KB)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@vendr.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr portal kickoff — inventory snapshot + next steps

Hi Liam — thanks for the export and the clear checklist. A couple quick notes from our side before we ingest: 

- Retention metadata: we require a retention_period and retention_owner for any S3-backed evidence. For TrueNorth Health the default retention should be 7 years unless the asset is a system-of-record doc (SOC2 report, contract) in which case 10 years.
- Historical vs active: please add a column named status with values ACTIVE or HISTORICAL. Historical items get a locked flag and are excluded from automatic rotation.
- S3 path: use s3://redwood-evidence-prod/vendr/truenorth/ for the initial import; we will revoke write after the batch.

I attached a working retention matrix (retention_matrix_TNH.xlsx) with our suggested defaults; Mina is looping in to confirm finer-grain owners. Ben is here for any billing/ingest-size questions.

If you want to proceed, set the batch to START=manifest_row_1 END=manifest_row_142 and we will validate the sample set (first 25 rows) before finalizing the import.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Security Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

Attachment: retention_matrix_TNH.xlsx (Excel, 14 KB)

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam@vendr.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 08:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr portal kickoff — inventory snapshot + next steps

Thanks both — a few clarifying items from the evidence operations side: 

1) Retention owners: I'm proposing the following mapping in the matrix: 
   - SOC2/Type II reports -> Compliance (owner: compliance@redwood.com)
   - Contracts & MSA -> Legal (owner: legal-ops@redwood.com)
   - Architecture diagrams / config exports -> Platform (owner: infra@redwood.com)

2) Evidence naming: can Vendr apply the filename normalization rule (lowercase, replace spaces with underscores, append profile_id at end) during ingestion? That will make downstream dedup/rotation simpler.

3) Sample validation checklist (please confirm):
   - 25-row sample unzipped into s3://redwood-evidence-prod/vendr/truenorth/sample/
   - Each file has a retention_period + retention_owner in metadata
   - Sample files include one SOC2 report, two cert snapshots, three config exports

If Vendr can confirm the normalization and metadata behavior we can approve the sample ingest window (Thu 09/23 02:00–04:00 PT).

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Security Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com

Hi Mina / Vanessa,

All good — Vendr will: 
- Apply filename normalization during ingestion (lowercase, underscores, append profile_id).
- Ensure retention_period and retention_owner are written to S3 object metadata for every file.
- Create the sample set at s3://redwood-evidence-prod/vendr/truenorth/sample/ and share a pre-signed listing by 01:00 PT on 2027-09-23.

We will not run the full batch until you confirm the sample validation results. I'll DM the S3 presigned listing and post the ingestion job ID in the Vendr portal.

Next steps:
- Vendr posts sample listing (ETA 01:00 PT 09/23) -> Redwood validates (complete by 05:00 PT) -> Vendr runs bulk import (window 06:00–08:00 PT).

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
